about_short_description.short_description: TruDoc facilitates patients with 24x7 access to doctors, psychologists, and wellness experts via voice/ video calls and live chat.

product.name: Chronic Disease Management
product.description: Provides ongoing management solutions for chronic diseases focusing on patient well-being and sustainability.

product.name: Integrated Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that allows users to connect with TruDoc doctors via voice/video calls and live chat, providing access to healthcare services while traveling or at home.

product.name: Hospital at Home Program
product.description: A service providing acute and chronic care at home with 24x7 telemonitoring and visits from doctors and nurses, supported by integrated Bluetooth devices.

product.name: 24/7 Access To Care
product.description: Offers round-the-clock access to healthcare services for timely medical attention regardless of location.

product.name: Health Record Management
product.description: Enables secure access and management of personal health records and medical history anytime.

product.name: Virtual Clinic
product.description: A service offering virtual clinics in various locations such as offices, schools, and hotels, enabling access to healthcare services remotely.
